reuse.why: Adds the guard to the existing link.ts module and follows the established assertAccountNotLinked pattern; it re-queries the account that each linker already loads a few lines later, rather than folding the check into that existing lookup.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule is defined once; the only repetition is the one-line call added to each of the six provider linkers, mirroring the existing guard calls.

placement.why: The guard lives in server/accounts/link.ts beside the other link-time preconditions, and it is called from the provider linkers in accounts/app.ts.

scope.why: Only the guard, its six call sites and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Clear and named for its purpose, but a new provider must remember two separate guard calls; a combined link precondition would be sturdier (and the test repeats the same assertion twice without varying anything).

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link paths call the shared link.ts guards.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic duplicated; the rule lives in assertAccountOpenForLink.

one_place.where: assertAccountOpenForLink in server/accounts/link.ts, called by every provider linker in accounts/app.ts (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking, fintegra).
